From: mail01@qingdaoharbouragents.example
Sent: 2026-10-12 09:00:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@vsllumenridge.example
Subject: RE: VSL-10 PORT STATE CONTROL - DETENTION RELEASED

Dear Colleagues,

The detention was released at 08:20 on 12 Oct after class confirmed rectification of the three deficiencies; 40.8 hours from the detention.

- Detained: 40.8 hours
- Released: 2026-10-12 08:20

Best regards,
Qingdao Harbour Agents

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-10 20:20:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@maritimeclassificationregister.example
Cc: mail01@vsllumenridge.example; mail01@anchorpoint.example
Subject: RE: VSL-10 PORT STATE CONTROL - DETENTION - CLASS ATTENDANCE

Dear Sirs,

Operator requests class attendance tomorrow and spare parts by courier; informs the P&I correspondent.

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@qingdaoharbouragents.example
Sent: 2026-10-10 16:00:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@vsllumenridge.example
Subject: VSL-10 PORT STATE CONTROL INSPECTION - DETENTION

Dear Colleagues,

The port state control inspection found 3 deficiencies: the oily water separator alarm not working, one fire damper seized in the engine room, and the emergency generator start failing once; vessel detained until rectified.

- Deficiencies: 3
- Detained from: 2026-10-10 15:30

Best regards,
Qingdao Harbour Agents
